arcs.blurb: A snapshot from long before Hogwarts.

arcs.blurb: School life before the exchange, while Malfoid is still pretending she doesn't care about Potter.

shorts.title: Poland, 1987
shorts.summary: A retro snapshot: Slytherin pride meets the Eastern Bloc.
shorts.text: Malfoid, 1987. Somewhere in Poland. Slytherin pride meets the Eastern Bloc.

shorts.title: Seen 2 minutes ago
shorts.summary: Her message is left on "seen", and she absolutely does not care. Obviously.
shorts.text:
Malfoid sent the message and saw: “Seen 2 minutes ago.”
She told herself she didn't care.
Twenty-seven minutes later, dark magic was filling the room and books were floating around her.
She still didn't care. Obviously. 🐍📱

shorts.title: Practising a smile
shorts.summary: She tries smiling so Harry will find her approachable; the mirror seems to mock her.
shorts.text:
Malfoid has decided that perhaps Harry would find her more approachable if she smiled occasionally.
Five minutes of practice later, she's convinced the mirror is mocking her.
Tomorrow, she'll try dark magic instead. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Sleeping princess
shorts.summary: Wake the sleeping Slytherin princess at your peril. Harry may get one exception.
shorts.text:
The Slytherin princess is sleeping. Wake her and face the consequences of dark magic. 😴🐍
Harry, however, may be granted an exception. Once. Maybe.
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Too much tea
shorts.summary: She tells herself she just made too much tea, and that it isn't waiting for anyone.
shorts.text:
She kept telling herself she'd simply made too much tea.🍵
Some feelings are easier to hide than to admit, even to yourself. Especially when a little warmth is waiting for someone who hasn't arrived yet. 💚
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The tiny visitor
shorts.summary: A tiny creature lands on Malfoid, and Harry sees how gentle she can be.
shorts.text:
She never understood why something so small would choose her. 🤍✨
Malfoid held perfectly still, afraid to disturb the tiny visitor. Harry had just discovered that even the coldest hearts can be gentle with the smallest things. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: A heart on the window
shorts.summary: A small heart drawn on a rainy window says what she won't.
shorts.text:
Some feelings are easier to hide than to draw. 🤍🌧️ Especially when a tiny heart on a rainy window says more than words ever could. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The ancient demon
shorts.summary: She summons an ancient demon. "You're not what I ordered."
shorts.text:
Malfoid summoned an ancient demon.
It was enormous, terrifying, and probably older than civilization itself.
She looked at it for three seconds.
"You're not what I ordered." 🐍🔥

shorts.title: Certifying a dragon
shorts.summary: Modern bureaucrats want her dragon certified; she handles it the traditional way.
shorts.text:
🐉🇪🇺 Modern bureaucrats tried to make Malfoid certify a dragon.
She chose the traditional method of dealing with bureaucracy.🔥
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Inclusive Magic Training
shorts.summary: Hogwarts brings in mandatory Inclusive Magic Training. Malfoid has questions.
shorts.text:
🪄📋 Hogwarts has introduced mandatory Inclusive Magic Training.
Malfoid has questions. Mostly about who thought this was necessary. 😐
"I was perfectly capable of casting spells before the training."
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Diversity quotas
shorts.summary: Hogwarts adds magical diversity quotas: "recruitment by spreadsheet."
shorts.text:
🏰📊 Hogwarts has introduced magical diversity quotas.
Malfoid studies the numbers in disgust.
“Apparently Hogwarts now recruits by spreadsheet.” 😐#Malfoid

shorts.title: The microaggression
shorts.summary: Calling someone "a wizard" may now be a microaggression; she reconsiders her career.
shorts.text:
🪄📋 Malfoid has just discovered that calling someone "a wizard" may be a microaggression.
She has begun reconsidering her career path.
The Dark Lord's rightful heir may be closer than anyone expected. 😐🔥
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The magic tax
shorts.summary: Casting spells now carries an environmental tax. How dare they.
shorts.text:
🪄💸 Malfoid has discovered that even using magic now comes with an environmental tax.
“Think about the environment before casting an unnecessary spell.”
How dare they put a price on magic. 😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Unconscious bias
shorts.summary: "Unconscious Bias in Spellcasting" training: knowing what you're doing is now a bias.
shorts.text:
🪄📋 Hogwarts has introduced mandatory “Unconscious Bias in Spellcasting” training.
Malfoid has spent seven years learning dark magic, ancient curses and defensive spells.
Apparently, knowing what you're doing is now a bias. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: A creature that bows
shorts.summary: "Oh, look, Potter. A creature that understands the importance of bowing before approaching me."
shorts.text:
“Oh, look, Potter. A creature that understands the importance of bowing before approaching me.”
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Burning the love letters
shorts.summary: Before leaving for Poland she burns every love letter. None of them was from Potter.
shorts.text:
💌🔥 Before leaving Hogwarts for her student exchange in Poland, Malfoid burned every love letter she had ever received.
The ones she opened were read purely for comedic value.
Not a single letter from Potter, though. 😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The Polish railway
shorts.summary: Her train is delayed. "I was promised punctuality."
shorts.text:
🇵🇱🚆 Malfoid discovers the Polish railway system.
Her train is delayed. Everyone is complaining. She remains perfectly composed.
"I was promised punctuality."

shorts.title: The dorm
shorts.summary: She arrives at a Polish student dorm the size of a broom cupboard.
shorts.text:
🇵🇱🏠 Malfoid has arrived at her Polish student dorm.
She was expecting wizarding accommodation.
Instead, she has discovered that two people are apparently expected to coexist in the size of a broom cupboard.
Her luggage has already filed a complaint. 😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: IKEA furniture
shorts.summary: Malfoid against flat-pack furniture: "And this is supposed to replace magic?"
shorts.text:
🪄🛠️ Malfoid has conquered Hogwarts, mastered magic and now faces her greatest challenge: IKEA furniture.
She studies the Allen key in silence.
“And this is supposed to replace magic?”😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The housing estate
shorts.summary: She discovers a ten-storey post-communist housing estate.
shorts.text:
🏢🇵🇱 Malfoid discovers a post-communist Polish housing estate.
Ten floors. Hundreds of apartments. Everyone living on top of everyone else.
She has questions. 😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Three days in
shorts.summary: Three days in: she should have stayed at Hogwarts. Where's Harry?
shorts.text:
🇵🇱📚 Malfoid, three days into her Polish student exchange program, has reached one very important conclusion:
She should have stayed at Hogwarts. And where's Harry when you actually need him?
She is now seriously considering burning the whole place to the ground. 🔥😐
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Day 4: the student social
shorts.summary: An international student social. She decides dark magic would be too dramatic.
shorts.text:
🇵🇱🎓 Day 4 of Malfoid's student exchange in Poland.
Tonight's activity: an international student social.
She briefly considered using dark magic on everyone, then decided it would be unnecessarily dramatic. 😐🪄
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The full tram
shorts.summary: The tram is full, and she thinks about making the passengers disappear.
shorts.text:
🚋🇵🇱 The tram is full.
Malfoid considers making the passengers disappear. 🪄💚
Public transport has been warned.
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The InPost locker
shorts.summary: Even Malfoid has to pick up her InPost parcel.
shorts.text:
Even Malfoid has to collect her InPost package in Poland. 🐍📦
Slytherin royalty meets the most Polish side quest imaginable.

shorts.title: Żabka at 10 PM
shorts.summary: One Slytherin, one hot dog, Poland's most dangerous place.
shorts.text: Malfoid discovered Poland’s most dangerous place: Żabka at 10 PM. 🐍🇵🇱 One Slytherin, one hot dog.

shorts.title: The coffee machine
shorts.summary: She finds the strongest magic in a Żabka: the coffee machine.
shorts.text:
Malfoid discovering the most powerful piece of magic in a Polish Żabka store: the coffee machine. 🐍☕🇵🇱
The Muggles are watching. She knows exactly what she's doing.

shorts.title: The ten-person queue
shorts.summary: Nothing prepared her for a ten-person queue at Żabka.
shorts.text: Malfoid has faced Death Eaters, exams and Slytherin politics. But nothing prepared her for a 10-person queue in a Polish Żabka store. 🐍🇵🇱

shorts.title: Closing time
shorts.summary: She came for an energy drink, and then the shop started closing.
shorts.text: Malfoid came to a Polish Żabka for an energy drink. Then they told her the store was closing. She has faced dark magic, but this may be the first time she has considered using it. 🐍🇵🇱

shorts.title: Biedronka self-checkout
shorts.summary: "PLEASE TAKE YOUR RECEIPT." The machine may not last the afternoon.
shorts.text:
Malfoid went to Polish store Biedronka expecting a dignified shopping experience.
Then the self-checkout screamed: “PLEASE TAKE YOUR RECEIPT.”
She has faced dark magic, ancient demons, and the entire Slytherin common room.
But this machine may not survive the afternoon. 🐍🇵🇱

shorts.title: Day 6: the bathroom
shorts.summary: She still hasn't recovered from the dorm bathroom.
shorts.text:
🚿🇵🇱 Day 6 of Malfoid’s Polish student exchange.
She still hasn’t recovered from the bathroom.
“If this is the standard, I may have to resort to dark magic.”
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Day 7: rain
shorts.summary: Rain, a good umbrella, and no Potter to share it with.
shorts.text:
🇵🇱🌧️ Day 7 of Malfoid’s student exchange in Poland.
A little rain. A perfectly good umbrella. And absolutely no Potter to share it with.
How terribly inconvenient. 🐍☂️
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Day 7: pierogi
shorts.summary: Twelve "enchanted" pierogi later, she wonders if Harry would like them.
shorts.text:
Day 7 of Malfoid’s wizarding student exchange in Poland. 🇵🇱
Malfoid has discovered Polish pierogi. She suspects the dumplings are enchanted. She has eaten twelve while investigating. Now she’s wondering if Harry would like them, too. 🥟🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Potatoes every day
shorts.summary: One week in: potatoes for lunch every day, and her faith is fading.
shorts.text:
🇵🇱🍽️ Malfoid is an exchange student from Hogwarts at a Polish wizardry school.
One week in, she’s had potatoes for lunch every day.
Her faith in Polish cuisine is hanging by a thread. 😐🥔
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The Polish wedding
shorts.summary: She survived Hogwarts. The uncle after three vodkas might be too much.
shorts.text:
Malfoid has been invited to a Polish wedding.
She has survived Hogwarts, but the uncle after three vodkas might finally break her. 🐍🇵🇱

shorts.title: St. Mary's Basilica
shorts.summary: In Kraków, the Slytherin princess is lost for words: "Oh… this is beautiful."
shorts.text:
🇵🇱⛪ During her student exchange in Poland, Malfoid visits St. Mary’s Basilica in Kraków. For once, the Slytherin princess is lost for words.
“Oh… this is beautiful.” 🥹🤍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Get on, loser
shorts.summary: Off to Hogsmeade. Malfoid has plans, and Potter carries the bags.
shorts.text:
“Get on, loser. We're going shopping.”
Time to go to Hogsmeade. Malfoid has plans. Potter is carrying the bags. 💚
And Malfoid is not a mean girl. She's just exceptionally particular about who gets to spend time with her. 
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Hogsmeade, halfway through
shorts.summary: Halfway down the shopping list, and still nothing suitable for Potter.
shorts.text:
🛍️ Malfoid has a shopping list. Potter has the shopping.
"We're halfway through, Potter. And I've yet to find you anything suitable."
Harry is beginning to question every decision that led him to Hogsmeade today.
Malfoid considers the afternoon a success. 💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Queen of Quidditch
shorts.summary: A song for the new Queen of Quidditch.
shorts.text:
🏆 The new Queen of Quidditch has arrived. Malfoid conquers the pitch with pure beauty, pure talent, and the instincts of a champion. 🐍
It's the hiss of the snake,
It's the thrill of the game,
Rising up to defeat every rival,
With emerald eyes full of flame.
And she's stalking the pitch,
With her victory in sight,
She's the Queen of Quidditch,
And she's claiming the night.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Slytherin vs Hufflepuff
shorts.summary: With Potter not playing, she can simply support her own House.
shorts.text:
Malfoid had never considered divided loyalties a particularly admirable quality. With Potter absent from the pitch, her allegiance during Slytherin’s match against Hufflepuff was perfectly uncomplicated.
One supports one’s own House, naturally. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The summons
shorts.summary: Why hasn't Potter told his Gryffindor friends they're together?
shorts.text:
🐍 Malfoid has summoned Harry Potter for a matter of considerable importance.
Why, exactly, has he still not told his pathetic Gryffindor friends that they're together?
Especially when that little red-haired Weasley girl seems to be looking at him all the time.
Malfoid expects an explanation, Potter.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Ginny's POV
shorts.summary: Ginny wanted a quiet word with Harry. Malfoid takes his arm.
shorts.text:
🧡 Ginny's POV: She was hoping for a quiet conversation with Harry. Unfortunately, Malfoid has never considered other people's plans particularly binding.
One arm linked through his, and suddenly Ginny discovers that Malfoid's definition of personal space is remarkably flexible.🐍
Harry, meanwhile, is discovering that every denial only makes things worse.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Spaghetti for two
shorts.summary: One plate of spaghetti, two souls, a stolen glance.
shorts.text:
The world forgot that true beauty and love need no explanation, only an open heart. Sometimes, it's just two souls sharing a plate of spaghetti, a stolen glance, and a moment so tender you wish time would stand still. 🤍✨
#Malfoid #HarryPotter

shorts.title: The annual review
shorts.summary: Crabbe and Goyle fail their annual review and must improve by September.
shorts.text:
Malfoid has completed her annual review of Crabbe and Goyle.
The results were disappointing.
They have until September to improve their fitness, appearance, and overall suitability as her companions.
Slytherin friendship comes with performance targets. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: Harry's POV: home for the summer
shorts.summary: One afternoon away, and Dudley has become her personal servant.
shorts.text:
Harry’s POV: You come home for the summer and find Malfoid drinking tea in the living room while Dudley has somehow become her personal servant. 🫖🐍
You’ve been gone for one afternoon.
Dudley has already lost his second bedroom, his dignity, and the right to sit down.
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The manicurist
shorts.summary: Aunt Petunia does her nails, and Harry is her nail-polish consultant.
shorts.text:
💚 Harry just wanted a quiet summer, but Malfoid has been visiting rather frequently.
Today, she's turned his aunt into a personal manicurist and appointed Harry her nail polish consultant.
"Potter, if you're going to be here anyway, you might as well make yourself useful."
The service at Privet Drive has never been better.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The investigation
shorts.summary: Harry gets a letter from a girl, and Malfoid opens a colour-coded investigation.
shorts.text:
💚 Harry received a letter from a girl. Malfoid opened an investigation.
The notebook has an index, color-coded tabs, and a family tree. The Ministry of Magic has fewer resources dedicated to Dark Wizards.
Harry may want to reconsider the security of his owl post. 😌
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: A Muggle restaurant
shorts.summary: Harry takes her out to dinner, and she orders for both of them.
shorts.text:
Malfoid wanted to experience a Muggle restaurant. Harry took her to dinner.💚
She ordered for both of them. Harry tried to object. She had already decided that sharing a dinner meant sharing a taste in food.
The waiter quietly chose not to get involved. 
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The zoo
shorts.summary: Harry takes her to the zoo, and she grills him about the elephants' trunks.
shorts.text:
Harry’s POV: You take Malfoid to the zoo, and she spends five minutes interrogating you about elephants.
“So, Potter, the principal attraction is that they possess exceptionally long trunks? Really, really long trunks? And people come here to admire them?🐘🐍💀
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The midsummer inspection
shorts.summary: At a Malfoy estate she reviews Crabbe and Goyle's training from her broomstick, clipboard in hand.
shorts.text:
Back in June, Malfoid had assigned Crabbe and Goyle a summer improvement plan. By midsummer, it was time for an inspection.
She summoned her school friends to one of the Malfoy family estates. As Crabbe and Goyle struggled through their training, Malfoid flew alongside them on her broomstick, clipboard in hand, conducting what she considered a perfectly reasonable performance review.
“Come along, ladies. September is approaching, and I will not entertain mediocrity.”
She had requested better fitness, a more pleasing appearance, and companions worthy of the Malfoy name. Hardly unreasonable demands. She was not asking for miracles. Merely results.
Some people regarded greatness as a gift. Malfoid considered it an obligation. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Crabbe's summer, I
shorts.summary: Crabbe trains all summer to become someone Malfoid could be proud of, and starts to have doubts.
shorts.text:
For years, Crabbe has remained a faithful companion to Malfoid, putting up with her teasing, her habit of treating her like air, and the occasional accusation that she cannot even read properly. Now Malfoid has decided that her appearance requires improvement.
Crabbe is spending the summer trying to become someone Malfoid could be proud of. Every exercise, every humiliation, every aching muscle - she puts herself through it all for her.
Alone in her bedroom, staring at Malfoid's photograph, Crabbe begins to question what years of loyalty have earned her. How much longer must she endure this treatment, and the constant feeling of never being good enough? 🐍
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Manners at the Dursleys'
shorts.summary: She works hard at being polite to the Dursleys, until Harry tells her she needn't bother.
shorts.text:
Malfoid really tried to behave herself around the Dursleys. She made a genuine effort not to obliterate them with dark magic.
The Dursleys, naturally, sensed that their lives and deaths rested entirely in the hands of this lovely, blonde creature with the cold eyes and impeccable manners.
Finally, Harry told her she didn't have to be polite.
A terrible mistake. A wonderful mistake. 🐍🍵
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Where Harry slept
shorts.summary: She asks Mr. Dursley where Harry's bedroom was, and her serpent pendant starts to glow.
shorts.text:
Last time, Harry told Malfoid she didn't have to be so polite to the Dursleys. Wonderful news, naturally. Still, a proper lady is a proper lady, and good manners are hardly a burden.
So, on their next visit, Malfoid did what any proper lady would do: she asked Mr. Dursley a few questions about Harry's childhood. And, quite naturally, where Harry's bedroom had been.
When Mr. Dursley answered, Malfoid politely asked him to repeat himself. She couldn't possibly have understood him correctly. Perhaps she was unfamiliar with some obscure dialect of Muggle English.
Then her icy eyes grew colder, and the little silver serpent at her throat began to glow emerald green.
Harry had told her she needn't be polite.
She had taken him at his word. 🐍
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Alone with Mr. Dursley
shorts.summary: Malfoid shows Vernon the difference between politeness and weakness.
shorts.text:
Malfoid has always believed that every gentleman deserves a fair hearing, every lady deserves impeccable manners, and every insult against someone she loves deserves an appropriate response.
Alone with Mr. Dursley, she is about to demonstrate the difference between politeness and weakness. He has mistaken her courtesy for submission, her patience for indifference, and her silence for permission. An understandable mistake, perhaps. But one does not survive long in pure-blood society by confusing a lady's restraint with an inability to act.
Harry returns at precisely the wrong moment. Or, depending on one's perspective, the perfect one. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: "Mercy...?"
shorts.summary: Vernon hangs pinned to his own wall, and Harry asks her to show mercy.
shorts.text:
The Malfoys have many traditions. One is never allowing an inferior specimen to dictate the terms. Vernon Dursley has had the misfortune of discovering this one.
Ten years of treating Harry Potter as a burden have brought him to this curious position: suspended against his own wall, awaiting judgment from a young lady who regards his existence as a breach of etiquette.
Malfoid has yet to decide how the lesson shall conclude. Then Potter, naturally, chooses this precise moment to complicate matters.
"Mercy...?"
A lesser woman might have mistaken restraint for defeat. But even the most righteous anger must eventually answer to the heart, and Malfoid has discovered that loving Harry Potter can be terribly inconvenient. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: A token of appreciation
shorts.summary: She spares Vernon but promises the Dursleys a "gift" they will keep for ten years.
shorts.text:
Malfoid believed in sparing mercy, swift justice, and defending the honor of her pure-blood name. Had Vernon Dursley's fate been hers to decide, ten years of cruelty toward Harry Potter would have earned him far more than a stern lecture and an undignified fall.
But Potter had intervened. Much to her own annoyance, Malfoid had honored his wishes. Harry had granted the Dursleys their reprieve. She would not take that gift back from him. The Uncle Who Lived, however, had yet to learn the full meaning of gratitude. Naturally, this did not mean the matter was settled.
“After ten years of having Harry Potter under your roof, Mr. Dursley, I believe your family deserves a suitable token of appreciation.”
A gracious smile. A perfectly measured pause.
“For every year you have deprived him of kindness, comfort, and the most ordinary pleasures of childhood, the House of Malfoy shall offer your household a gift of its own. Tomorrow, you shall receive it. You will keep it for ten years.”
How fortunate the Dursleys were to receive such distinguished recognition. The House of Malfoy has always believed in returning kindness. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Azkaban for two
shorts.summary: Harry admits he feared she'd go to Azkaban, and she says he'd better come along.
shorts.text:
Malfoid had been prepared to employ dark magic in the pursuit of justice. Instead, Potter confessed that he had asked her to spare Vernon because he feared she might be sent to Azkaban for harming a Muggle.
For once, the young lady of the House of Malfoy found herself without a retort. How dreadfully inconvenient.
She slipped her arm through his.
“Should the Ministry ever send me to Azkaban, Potter, I trust you will insist on accompanying me.”
“You want me to come to Azkaban with you?”
“Don't be absurd. I should hardly expect you to let me go alone.”
She continued walking, perfectly satisfied with this arrangement. The House of Malfoy had endured worse indignities. Besides, Dementors had never particularly troubled her. She regarded them as little more than miserable pets.
As for the Dursleys, their promised gift remained a secret. For now. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Crabbe's summer, II
shorts.summary: Crabbe's makeover becomes something she wants for herself.
shorts.text:
Crabbe had been given a summer to become someone Malfoid would find acceptable. She intended to fulfill that promise, no matter how many failed hairstyles, exhausting workouts, or frustrating hours before the mirror it required.
After years of teasing, casual dismissals, and Malfoid's endless criticisms, Crabbe had every reason to resent the task. Yet she kept going, still desperate to earn the approval of the very girl who had made her feel so inadequate.
But something was changing. She no longer wanted merely to become someone Malfoid could be proud of. She wanted to look in the mirror and finally be satisfied with the girl looking back.
Malfoid had set the transformation in motion. Whether she would get to decide what Crabbe became was another matter entirely. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The gardener's misfortune
shorts.summary: A backstory: how gardener Percival Beaumont met a Dementor and his cottage came free.
shorts.text:
Why was Malfoid so fortunate as to offer Harry Potter the gardener’s cottage at the family estate?
Because the previous occupant, Percival Beaumont, had suffered a rather unfortunate accident.
Beaumont was a respectable, hardworking gardener from an old pure-blood family of French ancestry. He had spent years tending the Malfoy gardens, never imagining that his career would end in a rosebush after an encounter with a Dementor.
This particular specimen was widely regarded as the intellectually challenged cousin of the entire Dementor family. Its evaluations were a catalogue of failure, and its habit of almost letting prisoners escape had made it a recurring embarrassment to Azkaban.
Poor Beaumont had simply been tending his flowers when the creature appeared. A ladder toppled, roses were ruined, and the gardener found himself at the center of a supernatural calamity. A lovely painting of young Miss Malfoy watched the entire scene from afar, her painted expression serenely indifferent.
Beaumont subsequently reconsidered his career choices. The cottage became vacant, and Miss Malfoy acquired a convenient solution to Potter’s housing problem.
How fortunate. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Nowhere to live
shorts.summary: With two weeks until Hogwarts, Harry has nowhere to live. The Malfoy estate has a vacancy.
shorts.text:
More than two weeks remained before Hogwarts reopened when Harry Potter discovered a rather inconvenient detail: he had nowhere to live.
Malfoid listened to his predicament with the aristocratic displeasure of someone watching a badly laid dinner table.
Fortunately, the Malfoy estate had suitable accommodation available. The gardener had recently suffered a rather unfortunate accident, leaving his cottage vacant. Her father, it seemed, had already heard quite enough about Potter. Malfoid delivered this revelation with a knowing sideways smile.
And so the matter was settled.
The House of Malfoy was expecting a guest. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Malfoid is hungry
shorts.summary: With the matter settled, it's late, and Malfoid is hungry. Potter will have to be useful.
shorts.text:
Having secured Potter's agreement to reside at the Malfoy estate, Malfoid considered the matter settled. She saw little reason to entertain further discussion. One generally knew better than to argue with a Malfoy.
Unfortunately, another matter demanded her attention.
Malfoid was hungry.
It was late, and most respectable establishments had already closed for the evening. Fortunately, Potter was still at hand.
Having accepted her hospitality, he could hardly object to a small service in return. Malfoid had every confidence that Potter would prove useful, even if he had yet to appreciate the full extent of his new obligations. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Fish and chips
shorts.summary: A paper-wrapped portion of fish and chips tests her dignity, and Potter offers to feed her a chip.
shorts.text:
In all her young life, Malfoid had learned that belonging to an old pure-blood family was no simple matter. Expectations to uphold, conventions to observe, and an endless list of things a young lady simply did not do.
Yet never had her dignity faced a test quite so grave as a paper-wrapped portion of fish and chips.
“Another indignity, Potter, and I shall resort to the Dark Arts.”
“Perhaps you could stop threatening dark magic every time something inconveniences you.”
The nerve of him.
Then Potter made an even more outrageous proposal: he offered to feed her one of the chips.
Malfoid considered the matter. She would permit it, naturally, on the strict condition that he never speak of the incident again. The reputation of the House of Malfoy was not to be compromised over a potato.
Potter solemnly agreed.
And beneath the warm lights of a late-night takeaway, the fate of the wizarding world rested on his ability to keep his mouth shut. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Malfoy Manor
shorts.summary: An evening walk to the Manor. "You'll be staying in the gardener's cottage."
shorts.text:
The fish and chips proved unexpectedly delicious, and Malfoid appeared to enjoy the evening considerably more than she would ever have admitted.
With supper concluded, they set off across the countryside by magic. Malfoid had insisted on showing Potter the view before taking him to the estate. She had always enjoyed a pleasant evening walk, and she saw no reason to abandon the habit merely because she had acquired company.
At last, she stopped.
Before them, beyond the ancient trees and sweeping grounds, stood Malfoy Manor. Harry stared at the immense residence.
“Malfoy Manor. The one place in Britain I never expected to see from quite this close, and somehow the very place I'm apparently going to live. I suppose we're really doing this.”
Malfoid turned to him, mildly astonished.
“Good heavens, no. You'll be staying in the gardener's cottage. Do try to keep up, Potter.” 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: A most satisfactory beginning
shorts.summary: Potter spends the night in the gardener's cottage, out of her parents' sight. Tomorrow they'll learn he's a guest; he's to be ready at eight.
shorts.text:
Young Miss Malfoy had arranged for Harry Potter to stay at the family estate without disturbing her parents. A most satisfactory beginning, all things considered. For tonight, Potter would remain in the gardener’s cottage, well away from the manor and any inconvenient questions.
“Consider yourself fortunate, Potter. By tomorrow, my father and mother shall have the pleasure of learning that you are our guest.”
Potter seemed less than enthusiastic about the prospect of facing her father again.
“Surely you aren't still concerned about our former house-elf? Whatever my father may think of your past interference in our household affairs, the Malfoys have more pressing matters to attend to.”
She delivered this reassurance with such indifference that it was difficult to tell whether she was comforting Potter or defending the family name.
Tomorrow, everything would change. For now, Malfoid had one final instruction: Potter was to be ready at eight o’clock. Punctuality, after all, was the least she expected from her guests. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Harry's dream
shorts.summary: Harry wakes to Malfoid leaning over him, until she turns into Lucius demanding what he's doing in his house. Just a dream.
shorts.text:
Harry opened his eyes.
Malfoid was leaning over him, her long hair falling around her face. Her icy eyes met his, and the faint smile playing on her lips was enough to make him forget every sensible thought he'd ever had.
“Well, hello there,” he murmured.
For once, Harry Potter was perfectly content with his circumstances.
Then he blinked. The smile was gone. A pair of cold grey eyes stared down at him instead.
Lucius Malfoy.
“And what, precisely, are you doing in my house, Potter?”
Harry's blood ran cold. He tried to speak, but the words refused to come. Lucius looked as though he were deciding which particular indignity Harry's presence represented and how best to rectify it.
Harry pulled the blanket over his head.
And woke up.
The cottage was dark and silent. His heart was racing. No Malfoid. No furious Lucius. No pure-blood patriarch demanding an explanation for his existence.
Just a dream.
Harry stared at the ceiling. He was going to need a lot more sleep before he could survive this family. He pulled the blanket over his head again. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Malfoid's dream
shorts.summary: In her dream she returns to the Dursleys' living room, wand raised at Vernon, with no Potter there to stop her. She wakes before finishing the curse, and wonders why.
shorts.text:
That night, Miss Malfoy returned to the Dursleys’ living room.
The familiar wallpaper. The fireplace. Vernon Dursley, suspended helplessly against the wall.
Malfoid stood before him, wand raised, her expression cold with indignation.
“Crucio!”
Vernon writhed in agony. She watched without a flicker of hesitation. He had spent ten years making Harry Potter’s life miserable. Now, for once, he was the one who could do nothing.
In reality, Potter had stopped her. He had spoken of mercy as the right of the strong, and she had listened.
But in this dream, Harry was nowhere to be seen.
Suddenly, she was close enough to see the terror in Vernon’s eyes. Her wand remained steady. Her anger had subsided, leaving a calm certainty that frightened him more.
“Avada…”
Moonlight.
Malfoid opened her eyes. The manor was silent. Vernon Dursley was alive. Harry was sleeping in the cottage on the grounds.
A small, satisfied smile touched her lips.
It lingered until she recognised it.
She could tell herself that Crucio had been a lesson. A punishment. Something Vernon deserved.
But Avada Kedavra?
Had she wanted to finish the spell... or was she merely relieved that waking had spared her the choice?
She closed her eyes.
The word remained unfinished. The question did not.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Lucius leaves for the day
shorts.summary: At half past seven, Harry watches from the cottage as Malfoid waves her father off. Their meeting will have to wait, and Harry dares to hope.
shorts.text:
Last night, Harry Potter had dreamed of facing Lucius Malfoy. He'd woken beneath his blankets, grateful to discover that the confrontation had existed only in his imagination.
Now, at half past seven, he watched through the cottage window as Malfoid waved her father goodbye. Lucius was leaving for the day, apparently to attend to ordinary business, while his daughter remained at the ancestral estate.
Harry wondered whether this was some peculiar Malfoy family tradition. Perhaps the head of the household went out to conquer the world while his heiress stayed home to ensure it continued running properly.
Whatever the reason, Lucius was leaving. Their meeting would have to wait. Harry glanced at the clock. Thirty minutes until Malfoid came to collect him.
For the first time since arriving at the ancestral seat of the House of Malfoy, Harry Potter dared to hope.
A grave miscalculation, perhaps. But hope nonetheless. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: 7:50 AM
shorts.summary: A knock ten minutes early. Harry opens the door with a smile, but it's Narcissa Malfoy.
shorts.text:
7:50 AM.
Harry Potter had ten minutes left.
Ten minutes until Malfoid came to collect him. Ten minutes until he had to face whatever the Malfoys considered a perfectly ordinary morning. But Lucius was gone, and Harry had a roof over his head, a bed to sleep in, and no immediate reason to panic.
Then came a knock at the door.
Early.
Harry's heart lifted. Perhaps Malfoid had decided to spare him the wait.
He opened the door with a smile.
Narcissa Malfoy stood on the doorstep, her icy blue eyes regarding him with the cool, aristocratic composure Harry had come to associate with the Malfoys.
“I'm afraid I'm not the person you were expecting, Mr. Potter.”
Harry's smile vanished.
“Mrs. Malfoy.”
Narcissa inclined her head.
For one brief, glorious moment, Harry had believed his morning was going well.
He had been wrong.
“May I come in, Mr. Potter?”
Harry stepped aside.
Eight o'clock was still ten minutes away.
He was beginning to suspect those would be the longest ten minutes of his life. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Narcissa's arrangement
shorts.summary: The cottage is vacant, the gardens need tending, and Mr. Potter needs somewhere to live. He prepared for the wrong parent.
shorts.text:
Harry had survived his first night at the Malfoy estate, avoided Lucius, and was now waiting for Malfoid to collect him. When the time came, however, it was not Malfoid who appeared at the cottage door, but her mother.
Narcissa Malfoy had a way of making even the most ordinary conversation feel like an occasion at which one was expected to conduct oneself properly. She regarded Harry with cool courtesy, as though his presence were neither surprising nor particularly troublesome. Whatever had brought her to the cottage, she seemed entirely at ease.
Mrs. Malfoy, it seemed, had already given the matter considerable thought. Her daughter had brought a guest home. The cottage stood vacant. The gardens needed tending.
And Mr. Potter needed somewhere to live.
Narcissa had no wish to upset her daughter by sending her guest away. Nor, however, did she intend to let the situation continue on her daughter's terms. If Mr. Potter found the arrangement unsuitable and chose to leave of his own accord, well, that would be his decision.
The arrangement, in Narcissa's estimation, was practically self-evident.
Harry had spent the night worrying about Lucius Malfoy. It was becoming increasingly clear that he had prepared himself for the wrong parent.
Beyond the cottage, the roses stood immaculate in the morning sun.
Harry wondered what had happened to the previous gardener.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Dracaena
shorts.summary: Malfoid arrives, tells her mother she recruited Potter yesterday, and takes his arm. Harry learns her name, and that he is now the gardener.
shorts.text:
Harry had barely begun to process Narcissa Malfoy’s job offer when a familiar figure appeared at the cottage door.
For one brief moment, he felt saved.
Surely Malfoid would explain that he was a guest, not a gardener... and that nobody had established whether he could distinguish a rose from a weed.
Instead, Miss Malfoy  greeted her mother and supplied his appointment with a history. Apparently, she had recruited him yesterday.
Harry distinctly remembered being offered somewhere to sleep.
She slipped her arm through his. Narcissa’s gaze rested briefly upon her daughter’s hand. A small understanding passed between them, requiring neither explanation nor acknowledgment.
His terms could wait until breakfast. His place at the table could not.
Then Narcissa addressed her daughter by name.
Dracaena.
Harry had scarcely had time to appreciate it before discovering that he was now, in her mother’s estimation, her gardener.
He wondered what Lucius would say. Neither lady appeared concerned.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: Breakfast in the orangery
shorts.summary: Asked what recommends Potter for the job, Malfoid lists his loyalty, courage and conviction, and not one word about roses.
shorts.text:
In the orangery, Malfoid had taken the chair beside her mother, leaving Potter opposite them. She seemed entirely at ease, occasionally recommending a dish he hadn't yet tried with the quiet assurance of someone who considered it her personal responsibility to ensure he didn't miss the best of the meal.
When breakfast was over, Malfoid rose and moved to the chair beside Harry. It was Narcissa who eventually returned to the gardener's job question.
“And what, precisely, recommended Mr. Potter to you, darling?”
Malfoid considered the question with the utmost seriousness.
“His loyalty. His courage. His determination to do what he believes right, even when doing so comes at considerable personal cost.”
Harry looked up. Not one word about pruning, planting, or the proper care of roses.
“He also has a rather admirable capacity for enduring unreasonable people,” she added, settling in as though this were simply another item on the list.
Harry stared at her. He had expected teasing, perhaps another elaborate scheme. He hadn't expected her to speak of him with such unreserved conviction.
Across the table, Narcissa let the answer stand. Her daughter had given her rather more information than she had requested.
Malfoid, meanwhile, appeared entirely satisfied with her assessment.
Harry Potter, newly appointed gardener of the Malfoy estate, could think of nothing to say.
Dracaena, naturally, appeared perfectly satisfied with the morning's proceedings. After all, she had merely told the truth. 🐍💚
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The tour
shorts.summary: Malfoid shows Harry around the gardens of her childhood, ending at a frost-covered shed: home of the family's pet Dementor.
shorts.text:
With Harry’s employment contract settled over breakfast, Malfoid offered him a tour of his future workplace. The walk permitted a little less formality than her mother’s table. She had undone the top button of her blouse, though her bearing suggested no comparable relaxation of standards.
Among the roses, Harry tried to imagine her childhood: summer afternoons beneath the trees, a whole garden in which to disappear. At Privet Drive, he had learned to keep out of the way. Here, he suspected, someone would always have come looking.
Her account of occasionally eluding the household did little to contradict him.
Then the roses thinned. The gravel darkened, and the morning warmth deserted a small timber shed. Frost traced its locked door.
Its occupant, Dracaena explained, was the family’s pet Dementor. Apparently, it meant well.
Harry had never been especially fond of Dementors. Keeping one as a pet struck him as a peculiar choice, even for a family whose preferences he was learning not to question lightly.
Dracaena was already resuming the tour. He followed, privately reconsidering the adequacy of his contract.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: House rules
shorts.summary: The west wing is private after midnight, the pond needs no feeding, the shed stays locked, and she will supervise the gardening herself.
shorts.text:
By the time they finished the tour, Harry had learned that the Malfoy estate possessed magnificent gardens, a resident pet Dementor, and several household customs he would have preferred to encounter before signing his contract.
Malfoid supplied the remaining rules with impeccable composure. The west wing was private after midnight. The pond required no feeding. The shed would remain locked.
Harry enquired about the gardening.
She paused beside a rosebush and lifted a flowering stem with delicate familiarity. Even the roses, it appeared, were harmless only under certain conditions.
He ventured that these particulars might reasonably have accompanied the offer of employment.
Dracaena regarded him with a small, indulgent smile. Naturally, she intended to supervise him herself.
Harry considered this reassurance.
It explained very little about the roses, but rather more about how she intended to spend the last two weeks of summer.
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning

shorts.title: The open shed
shorts.summary: The shed stands open. Malfoid, reading under the trees, explains the Dementor has been moved elsewhere for his comfort. Elsewhere where?
shorts.text:
By one o’clock, Harry had begun to suspect that gardening for the Malfoys required rather more vigilance than horticultural knowledge.
The shed stood open.
He had spent the hours since the tour exploring his new workplace. Malfoid, meanwhile, had withdrawn to change. He found her beneath the trees, her platinum hair loose over an emerald dress, a book open across her knees.
She received the news of the missing Dementor without concern. It had been moved elsewhere. She had noticed his discomfort and seen no reason to let it continue.
For a moment, Harry forgot the open door. Somewhere between arranging his employment and choosing a book, she had quietly rearranged part of her world to make him more comfortable.
Dracaena kept one finger between the pages and invited him to luncheon.
Only then did another question occur to him.
Elsewhere, precisely, where?
#Malfoid #HarryPotter #Yearning 🐍💚

shorts.title: "Bang!"
shorts.summary: Don't mistake her soft side for weakness. When the Dark Lord comes, she'll stand beside Harry.
shorts.text:
“Bang!” 💥🐍
Never mistake Malfoid's softer side for weakness. She's a witch, a master of the Dark Arts, and when the Dark Lord comes, she'll stand beside Harry.
Some girls make hearts melt. Others make Dark Lords disappear. 🪄
#Malfoid

shorts.summary: After the Battle of the Department of Mysteries, nothing will be the same.
shorts.text:
After the Battle of the Department of Mysteries, nothing will ever be the same again. Some losses can’t be undone. Some departures change everything.
Out of the Ministry. 🐍
#Malfoid

shorts.title: The Forbidden Forest
shorts.summary: "We'll win, right? We're not homeless?" "Of course we will."
shorts.text:
“Ouhhh, Harry, we’ll win, right? We’ll defeat the Dark Lord? We’re not homeless, right?” 🥺❄️💚
“Of course we will.”
Love conquers darkness.
Even if we have to live in the Forbidden Forest.
#Malfoid

shorts.title: After the war
shorts.summary: The Dark Lord has fallen, and love finds its way back into the world.
shorts.text:
The Dark Lord has fallen. The war is over. The world can finally breathe again. And as the darkness lifts, love finds its way back to the world. Perhaps this is what victory was always meant to look like. ❤️💚
#Malfoid
